Class ConfigFile

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.config.ConfigFile
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigValues
public final class ConfigFile extends Object implements ConfigValues
A YAML settings file read through typed ConfigKeys.

Loading never fails the plugin and never loses what the owner wrote:

  • a missing file is created from the ConfigSpec, with its header and comments;
  • a missing key is added with its default and comment, and the file is saved;
  • an invalid value logs a warning and uses the default (a clamped number out of range uses the nearest bound); the file keeps the owner's text;
  • keys the spec does not know are kept;
  • a file that cannot be parsed is not touched: defaults are used (or, on a reload, the old values).
The file is only saved when something was added, so an up-to-date file is never reformatted.
